CREATE TABLE we48schema.cust
(
    custid int,
    fname VARCHAR(50),
    lname VARCHAR(50),
    age int,
    prof VARCHAR(50)
)
WITH
(
    CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX,
    DISTRIBUTION=ROUND_ROBIN
);



COPY INTO we48schema.cust FROM
'https://wd37we48sa.blob.core.windows.net/wd37we48synapselake/data/custdata/custs'
WITH
(
FILE_TYPE='CSV',
FIRSTROW=1

);



select top 5 * from we48schema.cust;



-- view ( contains query )
-- virtual table 
-- only query no data 

-- security / limit / restrict 
-- always latest 

CREATE view we48schema.vw_test
as 
select * from we48schema.cust;

-- access 


select top 5 * from  we48schema.vw_test;


-- Materilized View 

-- like a view , but it will contain data as well 

-- incremental / auto refresh data when the underlying table got changed
-- performance 

CREATE MATERIALIZED view we48schema.mv_prof_agg
WITH (DISTRIBUTION =HASH(prof))
as
select prof ,count(1) as total from we48schema.cust GROUP BY prof;
